description: Agent Vendors: submit the refund and cancellation terms for one vendor engagement: the terms as written, read for wording that refuses refunds such as no refunds or all sales final, leaves them wholly to the vendor such as at our sole discretion or pays back in credit such as store credit, the refund window, the conditions a refund depends on, who decides (the buyer, the vendor, the platform, a third party or automatic), how the money comes back, how soon, how to cancel before delivery, the remedy short of a refund, fees taken from a refund and when the terms were stated; and optionally when the spend is planned. The signed report gives the remedy path with the window and the timeline in days and any blocking wording, each part (window, conditions, who decides, how the money comes back, how soon, cancellation) with its status, and counts the parts stated, the conditions and the fees, and names a remedy path that is blocked: refunds refused or a 0 day window, a refund at the vendor’s sole discretion and money back only as credit; then no window or one with no number of days, no conditions, no decider, no method, no timeline, no cancellation path, fees taken from a refund and terms stated after the spend, with the fix for each. This reads the whole remedy path before the spend: a warranty claim against its terms is wever_warranty-check, a refund claim against a policy after purchase is wever_refund-eligibility-check, the refund route for failed paid calls is wever_refund-path-check, a seller’s own checkout refund rule is wever_refund-rule-check and a guarantee against its terms is wever_guarantee-evidence-check. Verdict refund_blocked, refund_partial, refund_unstated or refund_path_clear. POST /api/vendor-refund-check. Reads only the recorded vendor material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no vendor is contacted, no quote is accepted, no order is placed and no spend is approved. Agent Vendors reads the seller on the other side of a spend before the agent commits: whether the vendor is who it claims to be, whether its quote and terms hold together, whether its price stays the same and what it costs to leave. It is not one service’s terms on their own (wever_service-terms-check reads one service’s terms by themselves; the vendor terms-match check reads a vendor’s terms against the specific quote or order in front of the agent, where a contradiction costs money), not pricing structure or fee evidence (wever_pricing-tier-check and wever_fee-evidence-check; the vendor price check reads whether the price this vendor quoted this buyer stays consistent across the quote, the listing and any invoice or prior charge), not single promise types (wever_warranty-check and wever_shipping-check; the vendor delivery and refund checks read the whole delivery promise and the whole remedy path for one vendor engagement), not listing accuracy (wever_catalog-listing-check reads whether a catalog listing is accurate; a directory or marketplace listing being present is not vendor verification, and no vendor check treats listing presence as identity evidence), not after the payment (wever_purchase-record-check and wever_double-charge-check run after a payment; the vendor checks run before the spend, while walking away is still free), not the buyer’s own permission (wever_spending-policy-check and wever_authority-scope-check read the buyer’s permission to spend; the vendor checks read the seller on the other side of the spend: permission is not diligence, and diligence is not permission), not a promise once made (the wever_commitment checks; a vendor engagement becomes a commitment only after the agent accepts it, and the vendor checks guard the moment before that) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a vendor check reads a counterparty, not an objective). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-vendors-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-vendors/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

conditions.description: The conditions a refund depends on.

decided_by.description: Who decides a refund: the buyer, the vendor, the platform, a third party or automatic.

fees.description: Fees taken from a refund, such as a restocking fee.

method.description: How the money comes back, such as to the original card.

remedy.description: The remedy short of a refund, such as repair or replacement.

text.description: The refund and cancellation terms as written, read for wording such as all sales final or at our sole discretion.

timeline.description: How soon the money comes back, such as 10 business days.

window.description: How long a refund can be asked for, such as 30 days from delivery.
